tagShapeMismatches.english: A morbid memory trap presents little danger, but it proves useful in revealing important and unsettling glimpses into an area's past. This {@variantrule haunted traps|VRGR|haunted trap} affects a single room or 30-foot-square area. When a creature enters the area, the trap's emanation manifests as faint, disembodied whispers. If that creature is still in the area at the start of its next turn, an illusory scene plays out, repeating some terrible event that happened in the area. This vision typically lasts 1 minute. When the vision ends, all creatures in the area that saw the illusion must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} of the area for the next {@dice 1d4} rounds. {@condition Frightened} creatures must take the {@action Dash} action and move away from the haunted area by the safest available route on each of their turns, unless there is nowhere else to move. After the haunted trap is activated, it won't activate again for 24 hours.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 恐怖記憶陷阱有一點危險，但它提供了展露重要、令人不安的區域過往的機會。這個{@variantrule 靈異陷阱|VRGR|靈異陷阱}影響一個單獨房間或30尺的立方。當一個生物進入這個區域時，這個陷阱的靈異現象觸發，顯現為一段模糊、空洞的細語。如果該生物直到它的下一回合開始時仍停留在區域內，則一個幻象場景開始播放，重現了某件曾在此地發生的恐怖事件。這個幻象持續1分鐘。當幻象結束，所有在此區域看過幻象的生物必須成功透過{@dc 10}的感知豁免，否則在接下來{@dice 1d4}輪內對此區域產生{@condition 恐慌}。{@condition 恐慌}生物在他們的回合裡必須執行{@action 疾走}動作透過安全路線逃離這個靈異區域，除非無路可逃。在這個靈異陷阱啟用後，它不會在24小時內再次啟用。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check reveals the trip wire and the net. A successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check using {@item thieves' tools|phb} disables the trip wire without causing the net to drop or the bell to ring; failing the check causes the trap to activate.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一次{@dc 15}的感知（{@skill 察覺}）檢定可以揭示出絆線和網。一次以{@item 盜賊工具|phb}進行的{@dc 15}的敏捷檢定會解除絆線而不令網落下或觸發響鈴；在此檢定中失敗會令陷阱觸發。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A successful {@dc 20} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check reveals the needle, but only if a character inspects the lock. A successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check using {@item thieves' tools|phb} disables the needle, and a check with a total of 10 or lower triggers the trap.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一次{@dc 20}的感知（{@skill 察覺}）檢定揭示了毒針，但這需要角色檢查鎖頭。一次以{@item 盜賊工具|phb}進行的{@dc 20}的敏捷豁免檢定會解除毒針，但檢定結果為10或更低則會觸發它。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Explosive gas fills the area. If anyone holds an open flame, it causes an explosion. All creatures in the area must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The flame is then extinguished.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 爆炸氣體會充滿房間。如果有人持有明火，他就會爆炸並對房間裡的每個人造成 22（{@damage 4d10}）點火焰傷害，成功地透過{@dc 20}的敏捷檢定只受一半的傷害。接著明火將熄滅。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The lever isn't hidden. A successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check involving the surfaces in the trap's area of effect reveals scrape marks and bloodstains on the walls and floor. A successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check using {@item thieves' tools|phb} disables the lever.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 拉桿並未被隱藏。一次{@dc 15}的智力（{@skill 察覺}）檢定會揭示處於陷阱區域內的劃痕和血跡。一次以{@item 盜賊工具|phb}進行的{@dc 15}的敏捷檢定能解除拉桿。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When an avalanche stops, the snow and other debris settle and bury creatures. A creature buried in this way is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, and it has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover}. The creature gains 1 level of {@condition exhaustion} for every 5 minutes it spends buried. It can try to dig itself free as an action, breaking the surface and ending the {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained} conditions on itself with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. A creature that fails this check three times can't attempt to dig itself out again.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當雪崩停止時，雪和其他碎片沉積並掩埋住生物。以此方式掩埋的生物陷入{@condition 目盲}和{@condition 束縛}，並且具有{@quickref 掩護||3||全身掩護}。該生物每被掩埋 5 分鐘獲得 1 級{@condition 力竭}。它可以用一個動作進行一次{@dc 15}力量（{@skill 運動}）檢定嘗試挖掘自己，打破錶面並結束自己身上的{@condition 目盲}和{@condition 束縛}狀態。一個生物三次檢定失敗之後，就不能再嘗試把自己挖出。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Everything within an area of heavy rain or heavy snowfall is {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB}, and creatures in the area have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on all Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks. Heavy rain also extinguishes open flames.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一切處於暴雨或暴雪的區域都視為{@variantrule 輕度遮蔽|XPHB}，該區域內的生物在所有感知（{@skill 察覺|XPHB}）檢定中處於{@variantrule 劣勢|XPHB}，暴雨還能熄滅暴露的火焰。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A creature that dies in a necrotic tempest rises as a {@creature skeleton} or {@creature zombie} (your choice) {@dice 1d10} minutes later.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 死靈風暴中死去的生物在 {@dice 1d10} 分鐘後會變成一個{@creature 骷髏}或{@creature 喪屍}（由你選擇）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A creature that starts and finishes a Long Rest in a psionic field experiences disturbing dreams and vivid hallucinations. The creature has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for {@dice 1d10} minutes after the Long Rest, with the source of its fear being the first creature it saw on finishing the Long Rest.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在靈能場中開始並完成一次長休的生物會經歷令人不安的夢境和生動的幻覺。該生物在長休後的 {@dice 1d10} 分鐘內獲得{@condition 恐慌|XPHB}狀態，其恐懼來源為長休結束後看到的第一個生物。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A quicksand pit covers the ground in roughly a 10-foot square area and is usually 10 feet deep. When a creature enters the area, it sinks {@dice 1d4+1} feet into the quicksand and becomes {@condition restrained}. At the start of each of the creature's turns, it sinks another {@dice 1d4} feet. As long as the creature isn't completely submerged in quicksand, it can escape by using its action and succeeding on a Strength check. The DC is 10 plus the number of feet the creature has sunk into the quicksand. A creature that is completely submerged in quicksand can't breathe (see the {@book suffocation|phb|8|suffocating} rules in the {@i Player's Handbook}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個流沙坑覆蓋大約10平方尺的區域，且通常深10尺。進入該區域的生物將從沙面向下沉陷{@dice 1d4+1}尺，並被{@condition 束縛}。該生物在每個其自己回合開始時會再下陷{@dice 1d4}尺。只要該生物還未被流沙完全淹沒，它就可以透過使用其動作進行一次力量檢定來逃脫。該檢定DC為10加上該生物已沉入流沙的尺數。一個被完全淹沒在流沙中的生物無法呼吸（見《{@i 玩家手冊}》中關於{@book 窒息|phb|8|窒息}的規則）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Whenever a creature expends a spell slot to cast a spell in a wild magic zone, roll {@dice 1d20}. If you roll a 20 on the die, roll on the {@table Wild Magic Surge|XPHB} table in the {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB} to create a magical effect.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 每當一個生物在狂野魔法區域消耗一個法術位來施展法術時，投擲{@dice 1d20}，如果擲出的骰子是20，則在{@book 玩家手冊|XPHB}中的{@table 狂野魔法浪湧|XPHB}上擲骰來建立一個魔法效應。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The cannon emits a burst of positive energy that grants itself and each creature of your choice within 10 feet of the cannon a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d8} plus your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 該火炮爆發出一股正能量，使其自身和你選擇的10尺內的每個生物獲得等於{@dice 1d8}加上你的智力調整值（最低為+1）點{@variantrule 臨時生命值|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: * Found in the {@item Deck of Many Things} as depicted in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在{@book 城主指南|DMG}的{@item 永珍無常牌}中可見描述。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The cards in {@adventure appendix D|CRCotN|11} are meant to be given to players whose characters gain {@deck Fragments of Suffering|CRCotN} in {@adventure chapter 6|CRCotN|6} (see that chapter for more information).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在{@adventure 附錄D|CRCotN|11}中的牌應該給予那些在{@adventure 第六章|CRCotN|6}中角色獲得{@deck 痛苦碎片|CRCotN}的玩家（詳見該章節以獲取更多資訊）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The cards on this page are meant to be photocopied and given to players whose characters win {@deck Medals of Merit|CRCotN} in {@adventure chapter 1|CRCotN|1} (see that chapter for contest rules).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 本頁上的卡片是為了影印並給予那些在{@adventure 第一章|CRCotN|1}中贏得{@deck 善行獎章|CRCotN}的角色的玩家（有關比賽規則，請參見該章節）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Glowing chains made of magical force appear and wrap around you. You have the {@condition restrained} condition until the chains are destroyed or you are freed. While you have this condition, you can't cast spells, and any magic items you're wearing or carrying have their properties suppressed. You draw no more cards. The chains are immune to damage and can't be dispelled using the {@spell Dispel Magic} spell or similar magic. However, a {@spell Disintegrate} spell destroys the chains instantly, freeing you. Another creature can also free you by succeeding on a {@dc 30} Dexterity check using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 由魔法力場構成的發光鎖鏈出現並纏繞上了你。你陷入{@condition 束縛}狀態直到鎖鏈被摧毀或你被釋放。當你處於此狀態下，你無法施展法術，你所穿著和攜帶的所有魔法物品的效應被壓制。你停止抽卡。鎖鏈對傷害免疫，無法被{@spell 解除魔法}或類似魔法效應解除。但{@spell 解離術}會立刻摧毀鎖鏈並釋放你。其他生物也可以嘗試用{@item 盜賊工具|PHB}以一次{@dc 30}的敏捷檢定來釋放你。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You gain the ability to cast {@spell Wish|XPHB} {@dice 1d3} times.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你獲得{@dice 1d3}次施展{@spell 祈願術|XPHB}的能力。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You gain proficiency and {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in your choice of {@skill History|XPHB}, {@skill Insight|XPHB}, {@skill Intimidation|XPHB}, or {@skill Persuasion|XPHB}. In addition, you gain rightful ownership of a small keep somewhere in the world. However, the keep is currently home to one or more monsters, which must be cleared out before you can claim the keep as yours.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你在{@skill 歷史|XPHB}、{@skill 洞悉|XPHB}、{@skill 威嚇|XPHB}或{@skill 遊說|XPHB}中選擇一項獲得其熟練和{@variantrule 專精|XPHB}。此外，你獲得世界上某個地方的一座小城堡的合法所有權。然而這座城堡被一隻或更多怪物所佔據，你必須清理其中的怪物來獲得城堡的宣稱。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The cards on this page are meant to be photocopied and given to players whose characters win {@deck Medals of Merit|CRCotN} in {@adventure chapter 1|CRCotN|1} (see that chapter for contest rules).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 本頁上的卡片是為了影印並給予那些在{@adventure 第一章|CRCotN|1}中贏得{@deck 善行獎章|CRCotN}的角色的玩家（有關比賽規則，請參見該章節）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The cards in {@adventure appendix D|CRCotN|11} are meant to be given to players whose characters gain {@deck Fragments of Suffering|CRCotN} in {@adventure chapter 6|CRCotN|6} (see that chapter for more information).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在{@adventure 附錄D|CRCotN|11}中的牌應該給予那些在{@adventure 第六章|CRCotN|6}中角色獲得{@deck 痛苦碎片|CRCotN}的玩家（詳見該章節以獲取更多資訊）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Alarm horns declare that undead are attacking Malar's Throat. Mercenaries keep the monsters out of the city proper, but people are trapped in the temple of Tymora and besieged by {@dice 2d6} {@creature zombie||zombies} and {@dice 2d6} {@creature skeleton||skeletons} led by a {@creature ghoul}. If the characters defeat the undead, the temple rewards them with 5 gallons of tej and a {@item potion of healing}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 警報號角宣告不死生物正在攻擊瑪拉之喉。僱傭兵阻止怪物進入城市中心，但人們被困在泰摩拉的神殿中，並遭到由一隻{@creature 食屍鬼}帶領的{@dice 2d6}只{@creature 喪屍||喪屍們}和{@dice 2d6}只{@creature 骷髏||骷髏們}圍攻。如果角色們擊敗了不死生物，神殿將獎勵他們5加侖的蜂蜜酒和一瓶{@item 治療藥水}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: An excellent {@item lock|PHB} (50 gp) that requires a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check to pick using {@item thieves' tools|PHB} (the lock's key is missing)
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一把優質的{@item 鎖|PHB}（50金幣），需要使用{@item 盜賊工具|PHB}並透過一次{@dc 20}敏捷檢定才能撬開（該鎖的鑰匙已丟失）

tagShapeMismatches.english: Some strange creature has wandered down from the Monastery of the Distressed Body. Such creatures might include an ancient security construct gone mad (use {@creature Oaken Bolter|MTF} statistics from {@book Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes|MTF}) or a {@creature Gibbering Mouther} with a mechanical skull housing its central brain.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一些奇怪的生物從苦難之軀修道院遊蕩下來。這些生物可能包括一個發狂的古老安全構裝生物（使用《{@book 魔鄧肯的眾敵卷冊|MTF}》中的{@creature 橡木投射機|MTF}具體數值），或者是一個擁有機械頭骨容納其中央大腦的{@creature 囈語之口}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Roll {@dice 1d6} times on {@table Magic Item Table A}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在{@table 魔法物品表A}上擲{@dice 1d6}次。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Roll {@dice 1d4} times on {@table Magic Item Table B}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在{@table 魔法物品表B}上擲{@dice 1d4}次。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Roll {@dice 1d4} times on {@table Magic Item Table C}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在{@table 魔法物品表C}上擲{@dice 1d4}次。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Roll {@dice 1d4} times on {@table Magic Item Table D}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在{@table 魔法物品表D}上擲{@dice 1d4}次。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Roll {@dice 1d4} times on {@table Magic Item Table E}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在{@table 魔法物品表E}上擲{@dice 1d4}次。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Roll {@dice 1d4} times on {@table Magic Item Table F}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在{@table 魔法物品表F}上擲{@dice 1d4}次。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Roll {@dice 1d4} times on {@table Magic Item Table G}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在{@table 魔法物品表G}上擲{@dice 1d4}次。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Roll {@dice 1d4} times on {@table Magic Item Table H}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在{@table 魔法物品表H}上擲{@dice 1d4}次。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Roll {@dice 1d4} times on {@table Magic Item Table I}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在{@table 魔法物品表I}上擲{@dice 1d4}次。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Flame-kin soldiers created as part of an abandoned weapons project are suddenly reactivated and run amok. These soldiers use the {@creature azer} stat block in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 作為被廢棄武器專案一部分而創造的炎身士兵突然被重新啟用並失控。這些士兵使用{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中的{@creature 火矮人}資料卡。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Rescue a guild member {@condition petrified} by an {@creature undercity medusa|GGR} that uses the mansion as its lair.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 救援一個被{@creature 地底城美杜莎|GGR}使用這個宅邸作為其巢穴而{@condition 石化}的公會成員。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Reality is frayed here. Casting any spell of 1st level or higher triggers a roll on the {@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB} table in chapter 3 of the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 現實在這裡被磨損了。施展任何1級或更高階別的法術，都會觸發在{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}第三章中的{@table 狂野魔法浪湧|PHB}表。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A mysterious stranger gave you a gift that saved your life while you were lost in the wilderness. Roll on the {@book Ally and Rival Identities table|EGW|5|Ally and Rival Identities} to determine the identity of the stranger. Then roll on {@table Magic Item Table B} in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG} to determine the item. If you roll a consumable item from the table, roll again.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一名神秘的陌生人給了你一件拯救你生命的贈禮，當時你正迷失在野外。在{@book 盟友和對手身份表格|EGW|5|盟友和對手身份}上擲骰決定神秘人的身份。然後在{@book 城主指南|DMG}中的{@table 魔法物品表B}上擲骰決定物品。如果你擲出表格中的一次性消耗品，重新擲骰。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A famous warrior trained you with what has become your signature weapon. You have proficiency with a martial weapon of your choice, and you own one such weapon. It has special features as detailed in {@book chapter 7|DMG|7|Types of Treasure} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}. You also have the {@feat Martial Adept} feat from the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一名著名的戰士曾用你標誌性的武器訓練了你。你可以選擇一種軍用武器獲得其熟練項，並獲得一把此類武器。該武器擁有{@book 城主指南|DMG}{@book 第七章|DMG|7|寶藏型別}中詳述的特殊特性（魔法物品規則—特殊特性）。你還獲得{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}中的{@feat 戰技專家}專長。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A famous mage saw potential in you and tutored you in the arcane arts. You have a spellbook and the {@feat Magic Initiate} feat from the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一名著名的法師發現了你的潛能並教授給你奧術知識。你擁有一本法術書和來自{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}的{@feat 魔法學徒}專長。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You were press-ganged into military service, and were left shaken by what you saw on the battlefield. You have proficiency with medium armor, shields, and martial weapons. You also have a random form of indefinite madness, determined by rolling on the {@table indefinite madness||Indefinite Madness table} in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你曾被強行徵入軍隊，戰場上的見聞讓你深受打擊。你獲得中甲、盾牌和軍用武器熟練項。你同時隨機獲得了一項永久性瘋狂，透過使用{@book 城主指南|DMG}第八章中的{@table 永久性瘋狂||永久性瘋狂表}擲骰決定。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You were visited by a demon lord in a dream. You awakened knowing the {@spell find familiar} spell and are now able to cast it as a ritual, but your familiar always takes the form of a {@creature quasit}. You also have a random form of indefinite madness, determined by rolling on the {@table indefinite madness||Indefinite Madness table} in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一位惡魔領主曾拜訪了你的夢境。你醒來後便習得了{@spell 尋獲魔寵}法術並且能夠將該法術作為儀式來施放，但你的魔寵將永遠會是{@creature 小惡魔}的形態。同時你隨機獲得了一項永久性瘋狂，透過使用{@book 城主指南|DMG}第八章中的{@table 永久性瘋狂||永久性瘋狂表}擲骰決定。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@creature giant boar} affected by the {@spell awaken} spell convinces the shrine's druids to cast the spell on other boars to strike back at a contingent of hunting nobles.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一頭被{@spell 啟蒙術}法術影響的{@creature 鉅野豬}說服了神殿的德魯伊對其他野豬施放該法術來反擊一個貴族狩獵團。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A dying {@creature veteran} who was {@condition poisoned} by the pools slaughters any person who is healed by the waters.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個被水池{@condition 中毒}而瀕死的{@creature 老兵}屠殺所有被水池治療的人。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A group of sirens (see the {@creature Harpy||harpies} entry in {@book chapter 6|MOT|6|Harpies}) take over the temple and lure new victims inside to drown themselves during high tide.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一群塞壬（見{@book 第六章|MOT|6|鳥妖}中的{@creature 鳥妖||鳥妖}條目）佔據了廟宇，誘惑新的受害者進入這裡，然後把他們溺死在漲潮時刻。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@creature giant octopus} under the effects of the {@spell awaken} spell hunts in the temple at high tide.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一隻被{@spell 啟蒙術}影響的{@creature 巨章魚}在漲潮時於神殿狩獵。

tagShapeMismatches.english: {@b Light Sensitivity}. A creature of the night sky, the Nyxborn has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight, while it is in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@b 光照敏感}。作為夜空生物，天裔生物在處於{@quickref 視野與光照||2||明亮光照}時，其攻擊檢定以及依賴視覺的感知（{@skill 察覺}）檢定具有劣勢。

tagShapeMismatches.english: One dungeon {@5etools hazard|trapshazards.html} such as {@hazard brown mold}, {@hazard yellow mold}, or {@hazard green slime} is abundant.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 地牢中存在一種如{@hazard 棕黴菌}、{@hazard 黃黴菌}或{@hazard 綠軟泥}的{@5etools 危害|trapshazards.html}陷阱，數量眾多。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A flying, gleaming sword (use the {@creature flying sword} stat block in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}) appears within 60 feet of an aberration, a fiend, or an undead, which becomes the sword's target. The sword deals radiant damage instead of slashing damage and knows the exact location of its target while the target is within the region. The sword vanishes when it or its target is reduced to 0 hit points.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一柄自行飛舞、閃爍光芒的利劍（使用{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中的{@creature 凌空劍}）出現在一隻異怪，邪魔或亡靈的60尺內，並將它們作為攻擊目標。飛劍造成光耀傷害而非揮砍傷害，並總是知曉目標在區域內時的準確位置。當它自身或目標的生命值降低為0時，飛劍會消失。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Bizarre appendages squirm beneath the ground and around trees or other structures within this region. Dozens of limbs burst forth, entangling anyone within a 30-foot sphere surrounding one random creature. Each creature in the sphere must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take {@dice 3d6} bludgeoning damage and be {@condition restrained}. Any creature that ends its turn in the area takes {@dice 3d6} bludgeoning damage. A creature can free itself or someone else within reach from being {@condition restrained} in this way by using an action to make a successful {@dc 14} Strength or Dexterity check (its choice).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 古怪的附肢在地面之下和樹木建築周圍蠕動。數十條肢體突然迸出，糾纏一個隨機生物為中心30尺球狀區域內的所有目標。球狀範圍內的每一個生物都必須透過{@dc 14}的敏捷豁免，否則受到{@dice 3d6}鈍擊傷害並受到{@condition 束縛}。任何在該區域內結束回合的生物都會受到{@dice 3d6}鈍擊傷害。一個生物能夠透過一個動作成功進行{@dc 14}的力量或敏捷（由其選擇）檢定將自己或觸及範圍內的另一個生物從{@condition 束縛}中釋放出來。

tagShapeMismatches.english: For the next 24 hours, any humanoid killed in the region rapidly decomposes and rises as a {@creature skeleton} {@dice 1d10} minutes after dying.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在接下來24小時中，任何在這一區域被殺死的類人生物會迅速腐爛並在死去{@dice 1d10}分鐘後復生為一具{@creature 骷髏}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Creatures in the region don't cast reflections. Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks made against those creatures have disadvantage, and the creatures have disadvantage on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) checks made against anyone who notices their lack of {@creature reflection|TCE}. When they leave the region, creatures regain their reflections, and the effect ends.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 區域內的生物不會形成倒影。對這些{@creature 倒影|TCE}進行的感知（{@skill 洞悉}）檢定具有劣勢，並且該生物對注意到這一點的物件進行的魅力（{@skill 遊說}）檢定具有劣勢。當他們離開該區域時，他們會重新獲得自己的倒影，該效應將結束。

tagShapeMismatches.english: One random creature in the region can sense the presence of nearby minds for 1 hour. For the duration, the creature gains advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks made to locate other creatures within 120 feet of it, even creatures behind {@quickref Cover||3||total cover}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 該區域內的一個隨機生物能感應到附近心智的存在，持續1小時。在此期間，該生物為定位其120尺內其他生物（包括處於{@quickref 掩護||3||全身掩護}下的生物）而進行的感知（{@skill 察覺}）檢定具有優勢。

tagShapeMismatches.english: One of the characters in the region must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be transformed into a {@creature blink dog}, as if by the {@spell polymorph} spell. The spell lasts for 1 hour or until dispelled.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 區域中的一個角色必須成功透過{@dc 15}的感知豁免，否則如同受到{@spell 變形術}法術影響一般被變形成一隻{@creature 閃現犬}。該法術持續1個小時或直到被解除。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The creature gains the enlarge or reduce effect ({@chance 50} chance of either) of the {@spell enlarge/reduce} spell for 1 hour.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 該生物在1小時內獲得{@spell 變巨/縮小術}法術的變巨或縮小效果（{@chance 50}機會獲得任一效果）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Roll on the {@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB} table in the "{@class Sorcerer|phb}" section of the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}, rerolling any inappropriate result.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在《{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}》中{@class 術士|phb}部分的"{@table 狂野魔法浪湧|PHB}"表上擲骰，並重骰任何不合適的結果。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The area is a wild magic zone. Whenever a creature casts a spell of 1st level or higher or activates a magic item, roll a {@dice d10}. On a 1, roll on the {@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB} table in the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這片區域是一個狂野魔法領域。每當一個生物施展一道1環或更高的法術，或者啟用一件魔法物品時，投擲一次{@dice d10}。擲出1時，就在{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}中的{@table 狂野魔法浪湧|PHB}表格上進行一次擲骰。

tagShapeMismatches.english: In the wilderness on their home world, the characters find a {@item spelljamming helm|AAG} in the wreckage of a crashed {@vehicle scorpion ship|AAG} (see {@book chapter 2|AAG|2|Scorpion Ship}) and run afoul of goblins who want to plunder the wreck.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在角色們家鄉世界的荒宇中，他們在一艘墜毀的{@vehicle 蠍艦|AAG}（見{@book 第二章|AAG|2|蠍艦}）的殘骸中發現了一個{@item 法驅魔舵|AAG}，並與想要掠奪殘骸的地精發生衝突。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@creature hadozee explorer|BAM} (see {@book Boo's Astral Menagerie|BAM}) needs the characters' help to slay a white {@creature kindori|BAM} (see {@book Boo's Astral Menagerie|BAM}) that keeps attacking her {@vehicle flying fish ship|AAG} (see {@book chapter 2|AAG|2|Flying Fish Ship}). The hadozee can't tell whether the kindori is mean-spirited or amorous. Perhaps it has mistaken the ship for a rival—or a mate!
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一位{@creature 哈多茲鼯猴人探索者|BAM}（見{@book 布布的星界怪獸展|BAM}）需要角色們的幫助來殺死一頭不斷攻擊她的{@vehicle 飛魚艦|AAG}（見{@book 第二章|AAG|2|飛魚艦}）的白色{@creature 鯨馱驪|BAM}（見{@book 布布的星界怪獸展|BAM}）。哈多茲鼯猴人無法判斷這頭鯨馱驪是懷有敵意還是愛意。也許它把這艘艦船誤認為是一個競爭對手——或一個配偶！

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@creature beholder} influenced by {@book the Abyss|MPP|0|The Abyss} has compound eyes and looks like a floating, cyclopean fly head. It promises not to destroy the characters if they bring it a corpse it has never tasted before.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一隻被{@book 無底深淵|MPP|0|無底深淵}所影響的{@creature 眼魔}擁有複眼且看起來像一顆漂浮的蒼蠅頭。它承諾如果角色們可以帶給其一具其從未嘗過的屍體，則不會殺死角色們。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@creature triceratops} influenced by {@book Mechanus|MPP|0|Mechanus} and composed of simple geometric shapes charges creatures that enter the angular canyons it inhabits. It moves only in straight lines and turns only at right angles.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一隻被{@book 機械境|MPP|0|機械境}所影響的、由簡單幾何外形所構成的{@creature 三角龍}會向進入其所棲息的稜角峽谷的生物衝撞而來。它只會走直線且轉向只會在直角處轉彎。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A desiccated {@creature giant frog} influenced by {@book Pandemonium|MPP|0|Pandemonium} screams whenever it opens its mouth. Its interior is even noisier.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個被{@book 喧癲空隧|MPP|0|喧癲空隧}所影響的乾癟的{@creature 巨蛙}每當開口時都會尖叫，而其體內更加嘈雜。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Wearing grim armor and displaying a rust-colored horn, a {@creature unicorn} influenced by {@book Acheron|MPP|0|Acheron} challenges all it encounters to mortal combat.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一隻被{@book 修羅場|MPP|0|修羅場}所影響的穿著醜陋盔甲、展露著鐵鏽色的角的{@creature 獨角獸}，向所有其遇到的生物發起殊死搏鬥的挑戰。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@creature couatl} influenced by {@book Limbo|MPP|0|Limbo} has color-changing wings and insists passersby convince it that they're worthy of existing. If the couatl isn't convinced, it has a 50 percent chance of either attacking or wandering off.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一隻被{@book 混沌海|MPP|0|混沌海}所影響的、有著色彩變幻的羽翼的{@creature 羽蛇}堅持要求過路人向其說服自己有存活的價值。如果羽蛇未被說服，則其有50%的機會進行攻擊或是離開。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A beautiful but vain {@creature flesh golem} influenced by {@book Arborea|MPP|0|Arborea} insists on following a character until the character sketches, sculpts, or otherwise artistically renders it.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一具被{@book 奔放之野|MPP|0|奔放之野}所影響的美麗但虛榮的{@creature 血肉魔像}堅持要跟著某名角色，直到該角色以素描、雕塑或者其他藝術形式來描繪它。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@creature clay golem} influenced by {@book the Beastlands|MPP|0|The Beastlands} has been transformed into the walking hive that's home to numerous {@creature Swarm of Wasps||swarms of insects (wasps)}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個被{@book 萬獸鄉|MPP|0|萬獸鄉}所影響的{@creature 粘土魔像}已經變成了一個行走的蜂巢，是許多{@creature 黃蜂群||昆蟲叢集（黃蜂）}的家園。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A kindly {@creature green hag} influenced by {@book Elysium|MPP|0|Elysium} invites passersby to join her for tea in her cottage made of sweets. She makes some of the best cookies in the Outlands.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一位被{@book 極樂境|MPP|0|極樂境}所影響的友善{@creature 綠鬼婆}邀請過路人到她的由糖果製成的小屋裡來喝茶。她製作的一些餅乾在外域中堪稱最佳。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A gnarled {@creature dryad} influenced by {@book Carceri|MPP|0|Carceri} seeks to entrap creatures within the root-snarled, prison-like cavern beneath her grove.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個被{@book 卡瑟利|MPP|0|卡瑟利}所影響的扭曲的{@creature 樹精}試圖把其他生物困在她的樹叢下的一個根系纏繞、如監獄一般的洞穴中。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@creature nycaloth} seeks to capture several monochromatic {@creature Hell Hound||hell hounds} influenced by {@book Gehenna|MPP|0|Gehenna}. The yugoloth seeks to sell the hounds to Fiends participating in the Blood War.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個{@creature 征伐羅斯魔}試圖捕捉幾隻受{@book 焦炎火獄|MPP|0|焦炎火獄}影響的{@creature 地獄獵犬||地獄獵犬}，這隻尤格羅斯魔打算將這些地獄犬賣給正在參與血戰的邪魔。

tagShapeMismatches.english: An {@creature ettin} influenced by {@book the Beastlands|MPP|0|The Beastlands} has one head with bovine features and one head with lupine features. It desperately needs help finding something both heads are willing to eat.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個被{@book 萬獸鄉|MPP|0|萬獸鄉}所影響的{@creature 雙頭巨人}有著一個牛外形的頭與一個狼外形的頭。它迫切的需要幫助，找到一些兩個頭都願意吃的東西。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Several gnome {@creature Mage||mages} seek help recovering their walking castle from a band of aggressive, spine-covered {@creature lizardfolk} influenced by {@book the Abyss|MPP|0|The Abyss}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 幾名侏儒{@creature 魔法師||魔法師們}尋求幫助以從一夥被{@book 無底深淵|MPP|0|無底深淵}所影響的、脊柱外露的好戰的{@creature 蜥蜴人}手裡奪回他們的移動城堡。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The characters have to retrieve a treasure from a group of mischievous {@creature Sprite||sprites}. The sprites are secretly defended by {@creature Mimic||mimics} influenced by {@book Elysium|MPP|0|Elysium} that take the form of tiny, whimsical cottages.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 角色們不得不從一夥淘氣的{@creature 小仙靈||小仙靈}手中奪回一份財寶。這些小仙靈被一隻受{@book 極樂境|MPP|0|極樂境}影響的{@creature 擬身怪||擬身怪}變成奇形怪狀的微型小屋的形狀暗中保護了起來。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@creature drider} influenced by {@book Arborea|MPP|0|Arborea} runs a {@creature giant spider} ranch. She hires the characters to hunt a rare breed of {@creature sunfly|MPP} (detailed {@book later|MPP|1|Sunflies} in this book) that, when fed to her spiders, will allow them to produce a remarkable type of silk.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一隻被{@book 奔放之野|MPP|0|奔放之野}所影響的{@creature 蛛化卓爾}經營著一個{@creature 巨蜘蛛}牧場。她僱傭角色們去搜尋一種稀有的{@creature 日光螢|MPP}（詳見本書{@book 後文|MPP|1|日光螢}），當餵給蜘蛛時可以使它們製出一種非凡的絲綢。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Within a {@creature gelatinous cube} influenced by {@book Gehenna|MPP|0|Gehenna} floats a gigantic fiendish skull. Numerous Fiends revere the cube and interpret depraved schemes and threatening orders from its quivering. A Celestial seeks aid in destroying the cube.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個被{@book 焦炎火獄|MPP|0|焦炎火獄}所影響的{@creature 凝膠方塊}體內漂浮著一顆巨大的邪魔頭骨。無數的邪魔崇拜它並從它的抖動中解讀邪惡的計劃與令人恐懼的命令。一位天族尋求幫助以摧毀該方塊。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@creature banshee} influenced by {@book Acheron|MPP|0|Acheron} appears as a fallen knight-commander with a legion of {@creature Specter||specters}. Guardians of the gate-town of Rigus hire the characters to help banish the phantom army.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一隻被{@book 修羅場|MPP|0|修羅場}所影響的{@creature 報喪妖}以墮落騎士指揮官的形象出現，麾下統領著一支{@creature 惡靈||惡靈}軍團。外域門鎮悍鬥堡的守衛者們僱傭角色們驅逐這批惡靈軍隊。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Allowed into the {@book forum|SatO|3|Forum} on an ancient contract, a silver-tongued {@creature pit fiend} invites Excelsior's orators to debate the worth of a soul. An angel asks the characters to take the podium.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 根據一份古老的契約，一名巧舌如簧的{@creature 深獄煉魔}得以進入{@book 大論壇|SatO|3|大論壇}。他邀請精益城裡的各位辯論者探討一個靈魂的價值究竟有多少。一名天使希望角色們能走上講臺。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The faith of a divine champion ({@creature gladiator}) begins to waver in the {@book Chandelier|SatO|3|Chandelier}, causing their cloud keep to shudder. A {@creature lantern archon|MPP} (see {@book Morte's Planar Parade|MPP}) asks the characters to erase the warrior's doubt before their fortress falls from the sky.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在{@book 吊燈|SatO|3|吊燈}，一名神聖勇士（{@creature 角鬥士}）的信仰開始動搖，導致他們的雲上堡壘劇烈搖晃。一名{@creature 聖光神使|MPP}（見{@book 莫提的位面遊記|MPP}）請求角色們在這位戰士的堡壘從天空墜落之前消除他的疑慮。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@creature sea hag} in the {@book Sacred Well|SatO|3|Sacred Well} tells one of the characters they will die at the hand of Gzemnid in five days.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個{@book 聖井|SatO|3|聖井}中的{@creature 海鬼婆}告知一位角色，這位角色會在五天內死在格澤姆尼德手中。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The avatar of an evil deity of war (use the {@creature planar incarnate|MPP} stat block from {@book Morte's Planar Parade|MPP}) emerges from the {@book Lion's Gate|SatO|3|Gate} to destroy Rigus.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一位邪惡戰爭神祇的化身（使用《{@book 莫提的位面遊記|MPP}》中的{@creature 位面顯化|MPP}資料塊）從{@book 獅門|SatO|3|異界之門}出現，意欲摧毀悍鬥堡。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@creature mummy lord} in the {@book Crown|SatO|3|Crown} commands General Braahg to implement an outdated strategy. Risking treason, the hobgoblin hires the characters to lay his superior to rest.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@book 將冠區|SatO|3|將冠區}的一位{@creature 木乃伊領主}命令布拉格將軍實施一項過時的戰略，冒著叛國風險，這位大地精僱傭角色們令他的上司安息。

tagShapeMismatches.english: {@dice 1d3} {@creature Displacer Beast||displacer beasts}, pets of the green hags, are on the prowl; alternatively, use {@creature Yeth Hound|MPMM|yeth hounds} from {@book Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse|MPMM}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@dice 1d3} {@creature 移位獸||移位獸}，綠鬼婆們的寵物，在此地徘徊；作為另一種選項，你也可以使用{@book 魔鄧肯鉅獻:多元宇宙的怪物|MPMM}中的{@creature 夜嘶獵犬|MPMM|夜嘶獵犬}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Guardian. The item warns you, granting a +2 bonus to your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} rolls if you don't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 守護者。該物品會為你發出警告，只要你未陷入{@condition 失能|XPHB}狀態，則該物品將為你的{@variantrule 先攻|XPHB}檢定提供 +2 加值。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Waterborne. This item floats on water and other liquids. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) checks to swim.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 水上漂。該物品可以浮在水或其他液體之上。你為游泳進行的力量（{@skill 運動|XPHB}）檢定具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on sight
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 生物在依賴視覺的感知（{@skill 察覺|XPHB}）檢定上有{@variantrule 劣勢|XPHB}

tagShapeMismatches.english: A band of {@dice 2d4} {@creature Kobold Warrior|XMM|Kobold Warriors} led by a white {@creature Half-Dragon|XMM} spots the party. The group questions the characters, then retreats to warn Kissethkashaan.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一隊由白色{@creature 半龍|XMM}帶領的{@dice 2d4}名{@creature 狗頭人武者|XMM|狗頭人武者}發現了隊伍。這群人盤問了角色們，然後撤退去警告基塞斯卡尚。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The airship travels at extreme altitudes for {@dice 1d4} hours. During this time, the ship is in an area of extreme cold (see "{@hazard Extreme Cold|XDMG|Environmental Effects}" in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|XDMG}) and reduced gravity: creatures' and objects' weights are halved, and creatures' High Jump and Long Jump distances are doubled.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 飛艇在極高海拔以嚴寒區域旅行{@dice 1d4}小時。在此期間，船舶處於嚴寒區域（參見{@book 城主指南|XDMG}中的"{@hazard 極度寒冷|XDMG|環境效應}"）並縮小重力：生物和物件的重量減半，生物的跳高和跳遠距離加倍。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The airship enters an area of strong wind (see "{@hazard Strong Wind|XDMG|Environmental Effects}" in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|XDMG}), which lasts for {@dice 1d4} hours. When the ship first enters this area, the crew member operating the ship's Helm must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, or the ship inverts.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 飛艇進入強風區域（參見《{@book 城主指南|XDMG}》中的"{@hazard 強風|XDMG|環境效應}"），持續{@dice 1d4}小時。當船舶首次進入此區域時，操作船舶舵板的船員必須成功透過{@dc 15}體質豁免檢定，否則船舶會翻轉。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@creature Flesh Golem|XMM} pursued by {@dice 2d6} {@creature Commoner|XMM|Commoners}
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個被{@dice 2d6}個{@creature 平民|XMM|平民}追趕的{@creature 血肉魔像|XMM}

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@creature Mage|XMM} who offers to cast {@spell Augury|XPHB} or read {@deck Tarokka Deck|RHW|tarokka cards}
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一位提出要施放{@spell 卜筮術|XPHB}或解讀{@deck 塔羅卡牌組|RHW|塔羅卡卡牌}的{@creature 魔法師|XMM}

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@creature Ghast Gravecaller|XMM} that commands {@dice 3d6} {@creature Zombie|XMM|Zombies}
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個指揮著{@dice 3d6}個{@creature 喪屍|XMM|喪屍們}的{@creature 妖鬼墳語者|XMM}

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@creature Mage Apprentice|XMM} terrorized by {@dice 1d6} {@creature Quasit|XMM|Quasits}
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一名被{@dice 1d6}只{@creature 小惡魔|XMM|小惡魔}恐嚇的{@creature 魔法學徒|XMM}

tagShapeMismatches.english: A random creature within 60 feet of you becomes {@condition poisoned} for {@dice 1d4} hours.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 距離你60尺內的一個隨機生物陷入持續{@dice 1d4}小時的{@condition 中毒}狀態。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You are subjected to an effect that lasts for 1 minute unless its description says otherwise. Roll {@dice 1d8} to determine the effect: on a 1, you're surrounded by faint, ethereal music only you and creatures within 5 feet of you can hear; on a 2, your size increases by one size category; on a 3, you grow a long beard made of feathers that remains until you sneeze, at which point the feathers explode from your face and vanish; on a 4, you must shout when you speak; on a 5, illusory butterflies flutter in the air within 10 feet of you; on a 6, an eye appears on your forehead, granting you {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks; on a 7, pink bubbles float out of your mouth whenever you speak; on an 8, your skin turns a vibrant shade of blue for 24 hours or until the effect is ended by a {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} spell.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你獲得一個持續 1 分鐘（除非其描述另有說明）的效應。投擲{@dice 1d8}以決定效應：       骰值為 1，你被只有你和距你 5 尺內的生物才能聽到的空靈音樂聲環繞；骰值為 2，你的體型增大一級；骰值為 3，你臉上長出羽毛構成的絡腮鬍，一旦你打了噴嚏，這些羽毛會從你的臉上炸開並消失；骰值為 4，你說話時必須大聲喊叫；骰值為 5，距你 10 尺範圍內，會出現飛舞的虛幻蝴蝶；骰值為 6，你的前額長出第三隻眼，使你在感知（{@skill 察覺|XPHB}）檢定上獲得{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}；骰值為 7，你一說話就會吐出粉色的泡泡；    骰值為 8，你的皮膚透出藍色，持續 24 小時，法術{@spell 移除詛咒|XPHB}可結束此效應。

tagShapeMismatches.english: {@dice 2d4} {@creature goliath giant-kin|BGG} (attitude: {@dice 1d6 + 4}) trying to retrieve an {@creature owlbear} (attitude: {@dice 1d6}) on a rampage after running away from its giant owner
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@dice 2d4} {@creature 巨人親族歌利亞|BGG}（態度：{@dice 1d6 + 4}）試圖找回一隻（態度：{@dice 1d6}）在逃離其巨人主人後暴走的{@creature 梟熊}

tagShapeMismatches.english: A merchant ({@creature Noble|XMM}) specializing in {@item Mechanical Wonder|FRAiF|Mechanical Wonders} sends the characters to meet the clever clock-worker Flurn Eightspoke (see "{@book Clockwork Memories|FRAiF|6|Clockwork Memories}" later in this chapter).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一位專精於{@item 機巧奇具|FRAiF|機巧奇具}的商人（{@creature 貴族|XMM}）派角色們去見聰明的發條工匠弗倫·八輪（見本章稍後的"{@book 發條記憶|FRAiF|6|發條記憶}"）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@creature Mage|XMM} using a {@item Mechanical Wonder|FRAiF} (mobility) barters with a merchant for rare spell components.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一名使用{@item 機巧奇具|FRAiF}（機動性）的{@creature 魔法師|XMM}正在與商人交易稀有法術材料。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@creature Shambling Mound|XMM} created by {@book Moander's|FRAiF|2|Moander, God of Rot} corruption fights any living thing it sees.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個由{@book 摩安多的|FRAiF|2|莫安德爾，腐朽之神}腐敗所創造的{@creature 蔓生怪|XMM}會攻擊它看到的任何活物。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A bloodcursed {@creature Berserker|XMM} from {@book Dougan's Hole|FRAiF|3|Dougan's Hole} fights the characters.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個來自{@book 道根之洞|FRAiF|3|道根之洞}的血咒{@creature 狂戰士|XMM}與角色們戰鬥。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A group of {@dice 2d6} {@creature Tough|XMM|Toughs} from the {@book Reghed Glacier|FRAiF|3|Reghed Glacier} spots the characters and approaches.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一群來自{@book 瑞格冰川|FRAiF|3|瑞格冰川}的{@dice 2d6}個{@creature 打手|XMM|打手們}發現了角色們並靠近。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@table Whirlpools; Whirlpool Rank|GoS|rank 2 whirlpool} connected to the Elemental Plane of Water (see "{@variantrule Ocean Environs|GoS|Whirlpools}" from Appendix A of {@i Ghosts of Saltmarsh})
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個連線到水元素位面的{@table 漩渦; 漩渦等級|GoS|2級旋渦}（見《{@i 鹽沼幽魂}》附錄A中的"{@variantrule 海洋環境|GoS|漩渦}"）

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@table Whirlpools; Whirlpool Rank|GoS|rank 3 whirlpool} connected to the Elemental Plane of Water (see "{@variantrule Ocean Environs|GoS|Whirlpools}" from Appendix A of {@i Ghosts of Saltmarsh})
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個與水元素位面相連的{@table 漩渦; 漩渦等級|GoS|3級旋渦}（參見《{@i 鹽沼幽魂}》附錄A中的"{@variantrule 海洋環境|GoS|漩渦}"）

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@table Whirlpools; Whirlpool Rank|GoS|rank 4 whirlpool} connected to the Elemental Plane of Water (see "{@variantrule Ocean Environs|GoS|Whirlpools}" from Appendix A of {@i Ghosts of Saltmarsh})
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個連線到水元素位面的{@table 漩渦; 漩渦等級|GoS|4級旋渦}（見《{@i 鹽沼幽魂}》附錄A中的"{@variantrule 海洋環境|GoS|漩渦}"）

tagShapeMismatches.english: Tainted water that exposes creatures that move through it to {@disease sight rot} (see "{@book Diseases|DMG|8|Diseases}" in chapter 8 of the {@italic Dungeon Master's Guide})
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 汙染的水，使透過它的生物暴露於{@disease 腐眼症}（見《{@italic 城主指南}》第8章的"{@book 疾病|DMG|8|疾病}"）

tagShapeMismatches.english: A sunken galleon with a 50% chance of a random treasure hoard inside (roll on the {@table Treasure Hoard: Challenge 5—10|DMG} table in chapter 7 of the {@italic Dungeon Master's Guide})
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一艘沉沒的大型帆船，內有50%機率藏有隨機寶藏（在{@italic 城主指南}第7章的{@table 庫藏寶藏：挑戰等級5—10|DMG}表格上擲骰）

numericDifferences.english: A narrow wooden beam spans the length of this hundred-foot-long, fifty-foot-wide chamber. The beam crosses a twenty-five-foot-deep pit filled with slowly turning, bloodstained gears. The chamber's side walls, each 25 feet from the balance beam, are made of smooth metal sheeting.
numericDifferences.localized: 一根狹窄的木橫樑橫跨了這個100尺長、50尺寬的密閣。橫樑穿過一個二十五尺深的坑，坑裡佈滿了緩慢轉動、血跡斑斑的齒輪。密閣的側牆，每面距離平衡獨木橋25尺，由光滑的金屬板製成。

numericDifferences.english: A falling net trap uses a trip wire to release a weighted, 10-foot-square {@item Net|XPHB} suspended from the ceiling. The trip wire is 3 inches off the ground and stretches between two columns or trees.
numericDifferences.localized: 落網陷阱使用絆線來釋放懸掛在天花板上的十尺見方的{@item Net|XPHB|捕網}。絆線離地面3英寸，架在兩根立柱或樹幹之間。

numericDifferences.english: The malfunctioning Phase Transference Emitter consists of two primary components. The power battery is a 10-foot circular matrix of conduction coils wired directly to a generator via a secure power cable. The coils have ten nodes that connect to a large eight-foot tall cylindrical steel emitter rigged on a swivel.
numericDifferences.localized: 故障的相位轉移發射器由兩個主要部分組成。電源電池是一個10尺直徑的傳導線圈矩陣，透過一根安全電源電纜直接連線到發電機。線圈有十個節點，連線到一個大型的8尺高的圓柱形鋼製發射器上，該發射器安裝在一個旋轉裝置上。

numericDifferences.english: This gold key is 4 feet long and weighs 100 pounds. One round after it is removed from the sword stand, it comes to life, revealing itself to be a living object (use the {@creature flying sword} stat block). The key does everything it can to return to its stand, attacking anyone who tries to stop it. If the key is destroyed by reducing it to 0 hit points, it must be repaired (such as with the {@spell Mending} spell) before it can be used in the skull door.
numericDifferences.localized: 這把黃金鑰匙長4尺，重100磅。在它被從劍架上取下的1輪後，他會獲得生命，使自己變化一個活體的物件（使用 {@creature flying sword||凌空劍} 的資料）。這把鑰匙會盡自己可能的嘗試返回它的劍架上，並會攻擊任何阻攔它的生物。如果鑰匙因為生命值歸零而被摧毀，則它必須被修復（例如使用法術 {@spell Mending||修復術}）之後才能被用來開啟頭骨之門。

numericDifferences.english: Traveling at altitudes of 10,000 feet or higher above sea level is taxing for most creatures because of the reduced amount of oxygen in the air. Each hour such a creature spends traveling at high altitude counts as 2 hours for the purpose of determining how long that creature can travel (see "{@book Travel Pace|XDMG|1|Travel Pace}" in {@book chapter 2|XDMG|1}).
numericDifferences.localized: 由於空氣中的氧氣含量減少的原因，在海拔10000尺或更高的地方旅行對大多數生物來說都是一種負擔。計算生物的旅行時間時，生物在高海拔地區旅行的每1個小時都被算作2個小時（見{@book 第二章|XDMG|1} {@book 旅行步調|XDMG|1|Travel Pace} 一節）。

numericDifferences.english: A lightning storm lasts for 1 hour. After each minute spent in the area of a lightning storm, a creature rolls {@b {@dice 1d6}}; on a 1, lightning streaks down to strike the creature. The creature makes a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@b {@dice 3d10}} Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
numericDifferences.localized: 閃電風暴持續1小時。在閃電風暴區域內每停留1分鐘後，生物需投擲{@b {@dice 1d6}}；結果為1時，閃電會劈下打擊該生物。該生物需進行{@dc 15}的敏捷豁免，豁免失敗則受到{@b {@dice 3d10}}閃電傷害，豁免成功則只受一半傷害。

numericDifferences.english: A creature needs an amount of food per day based on its size, as shown in the Food Needs per Day table. A creature that eats but consumes less than half the required food for a day must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB|saving throw} or gain 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level at the day's end. A creature that eats nothing for 5 days automatically gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level at the end of the fifth day as well as an additional level at the end of each subsequent day without food.
numericDifferences.localized: 生物每天需要攝入一定量的食物，其需求量由體型決定，如下方每日食物需求表所示。若生物在一天中吃下的食物低於這個量的一半，其在本日結束時必須透過一次{@dc 10}的體質{@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB|豁免檢定}，否則將會獲得 1 級{@condition Exhaustion|XPHB|力竭}等級。而連續五天什麼也不吃的生物會在第五天結束時自動獲得 1 層額外的{@condition Exhaustion|XPHB|力竭}等級，在這之後若繼續什麼也不吃，其每天結束時都將會獲得1層額外的力竭等級。

numericDifferences.english: The winds of {@book Pandemonium|XDMG|5|Pandemonium} are common in Pandemonium and regions where its influence is felt, including parts of the Underdark. A creature makes a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw after each hour spent among the howling winds. On a failed save, the creature gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level. The winds can't increase a creature's {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level above 3. Finishing a Long Rest doesn't reduce a creature's Exhaustion level unless the creature can somehow escape the winds.
numericDifferences.localized: 喧癲空隧的狂風常出現在{@book 喧癲空隧|XDMG|5|Pandemonium}位面和受其影響的地區，包括幽暗地域的部分地區。一個生物在尖嘯狂風中每經過1個小時將進行一次{@dc 10}的感知豁免，如果豁免失敗，該生物獲得1級{@condition Exhaustion|XPHB|力竭}。狂風不能將生物的{@condition Exhaustion|XPHB|力竭}等級提高到3級以上。長休無法降低狂風中的生物的力竭等級，除非該生物能夠以某種方式避開狂風肆虐。

numericDifferences.english: Poisonous gas is usually encountered in an enclosed space, such as a sewer or sealed tomb. The gas fills as much space as it can, up to a maximum of ten 10-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cubes}. The transparent gas carries a foul odor. The gas is continuously or periodically replenished by some natural or magical source, though a strong wind disperses the gas for 1 minute.
numericDifferences.localized: 毒氣常見於封閉空間內，如下水道或者封閉的墓穴中。毒氣會儘可能地填滿空間，最大覆蓋範圍為十個10尺{@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|立方}。這種透明的氣體帶有腐臭味，它會持續地或者週期性地由其天然源頭或魔法源頭補充，但一陣強風能將毒氣驅散長達一分鐘。

numericDifferences.english: A creature that has neither the Incapacitated nor the Restrained condition can spend 1 minute freeing another creature buried by the rockslide.
numericDifferences.localized: 一個沒有處於失能和束縛狀態的生物可以花費一分鐘，救出被巖崩掩埋的另一個生物。

numericDifferences.english: Yellow mold grows in dark places, and one patch covers a 5-foot square. If touched, the mold ejects a cloud of spores that fills a 10-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}. Any creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Poison damage and have the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. While Poisoned in this way, the creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
numericDifferences.localized: 黃黴菌生在陰暗處，每片黃黴菌覆蓋5尺方形區域。如果被觸碰，黃黴菌會噴射出一片覆蓋10尺{@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|立方}的孢子云。任何處於此區域內的生物必須成功透過一次{@dc 15}的體質豁免，否則將受到11（{@damage 2d10}）點毒素傷害，並在接下來的一分鐘內陷入{@condition Poisoned|XPHB|中毒}狀態。以此法中毒的生物在其每個回合開始時受到5（{@damage 1d10}）點毒素傷害。生物在每個自己的回合結束時重新豁免，豁免成功則效應終止。

numericDifferences.localized: {@atkr r}：{@hit 6}，射程600/2400尺。{@h}：44（{@damage 8d10}）鈍擊傷害。

numericDifferences.english: A tarokka deck has fifty-four cards, each of which has its own name. Forty of them comprise the common deck, which is divided into four suits: swords, coins, stars, and glyphs.
numericDifferences.localized: 一副塔羅卡套牌由54張牌組成,每一張都有自己的名字。其中四十張被稱為普通牌，普通牌被分為四組：寶劍、錢幣、星星和雕文。

numericDifferences.english: Each suit contains cards numbered one through nine, plus a tenth card that is called the master of that suit. A card can be referred to by its suit designation or by its name. For instance, the three of glyphs is also known as the {@card healer|Tarokka Deck|CoS}, and the {@card wizard|Tarokka Deck|CoS} card is also known as the master of stars.
numericDifferences.localized: 每一組牌都用1~9編號，加上被稱為主牌的第10張。用名字或者編號都可以稱呼一張牌，比如，雕文3:{@card 醫療師|塔羅卡牌組|CoS}、星星主牌:{@card 法師|塔羅卡牌組|CoS}。

numericDifferences.english: The remaining fourteen cards make up the high deck, which symbolizes the natural forces of the multiverse. These cards are represented by a crown symbol and are the most powerful cards in the deck.
numericDifferences.localized: 其餘14張牌是至高牌，象徵著多元宇宙的自然力量。這些牌都有王冠標記，是整套牌組中最強力的牌。

numericDifferences.english: Each suit contains cards numbered one through nine, plus a tenth card called the master of that suit. One can refer to a card by its suit designation or by its name. For instance, the six of stars is also known as the evoker, and the master of coins is the rogue.
numericDifferences.localized: 每個花色包含編號從一到九的卡牌，外加一張稱為該花色主牌的第十張牌。可以透過其花色編號或名稱來指代一張牌。例如，星辰 6 也被稱為塑能師，而錢幣主牌則是浪客。

numericDifferences.english: When using the tarokka deck, you can let the card's suit add extra dimension to your results. The four of coins might encourage you to link that aspect of the {@book Darklord|RHW|4|Creating a Darklord} to wealth, while the four of swords could provide an interpretation rooted in violence.
numericDifferences.localized: 使用塔羅卡牌組時，你可以讓卡牌的花色為你的結果增添額外的維度。錢幣 4 可能會鼓勵你將{@book 黑暗領主|RHW|4|Creating a Darklord}的那個方面與財富聯絡起來，而寶劍 4 則可能提供一個根植於暴力的解讀。

numericDifferences.english: You control fate in your adventures. If you don't know what a tarokka card means during a reading, note that and fulfill its prophecy in the future. For example, if the four of glyphs appears in a reading, its imagery might appear later as a shepherd NPC, a hooked staff, a wandering sheep, four runes, or the like. You can then tell the players about the connection between the image and the reading.
numericDifferences.localized: 你在冒險中掌控命運。如果你在一次占卜中不知道一張塔羅卡卡牌的含義，記下它並在未來實現其預言。例如，如果雕紋 4 出現在一次占卜中，其意象可能稍後以一位牧人NPC、一根鉤頭法杖、一隻迷途的綿羊、四個符文或類似事物的形式出現。然後你可以告訴玩家這個意象與占卜之間的聯絡。

numericDifferences.english: You immediately drop to 0 hit points, have the {@condition unconscious} condition, and must begin making death saving throws. Spells and other magical effects that restore hit points have no effect on you until you are stabilized. If you fail three death saving throws, you die and can be resurrected only by the {@spell Wish} spell.
numericDifferences.localized: 你的生命值立刻變為0，並陷入{@condition unconscious||昏迷}，必須立刻開始進行死亡豁免，法術和其他能夠恢復生命值的魔法效果對你無效直到你傷勢穩定。如果你死亡豁免失敗3次，你將死亡並且只能被{@spell Wish||祈願術}復活。

numericDifferences.english: The fey crossing appears as a shimmering fractal of light above the deck, and it remains open for 1 minute after the card is drawn. The precise location in the Feywild to which the fey crossing leads is determined by the DM.
numericDifferences.localized: 妖精荒野通道呈現為牌組上方閃亮的分形圖案光芒，它會在卡牌被抽取後持續開放一分鐘，該通道前往的妖精荒野中的具體位置由DM決定。

numericDifferences.english: At any time you choose within 1 year of drawing this card, you can mentally name or describe an object or individual that is familiar to you. You immediately know the location of the object or individual, as well as the distance between you and the object or individual, even if the object or individual is on a different plane of existence. If you named an individual, you know if they are alive and any conditions they have. If you named an object, you know if it is broken or not. If you named a magic item that has charges, you know how many charges it has remaining.
numericDifferences.localized: 在你抽到這張卡後的一年以內的任何時間，你可以在心中指名你熟悉的一件物品、一個人的名字或是描述它。你立刻知曉其位置，以及你們之間的距離，即便它在不同的存在位面。如果你指名一個人，你知曉它是否或者以及它的狀態。如果你指名一個物件，你知道它是否損壞。如果你指名一件具有充能的魔法物品，你知道它還剩下多少充能。

numericDifferences.english: At any time you choose within 1 year of drawing this card, you can cast the {@spell True Resurrection} spell once without expending a spell slot or requiring material components. Use your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as the spellcasting ability (your choice).
numericDifferences.localized: 在你抽到卡牌後一年內的任意時間，你可以施展一次{@spell True Resurrection||完全復生術}法術，無需法術位和材料成分。使用你的智力、感知或魅力作為施法屬性（由你選擇）。

numericDifferences.english: Grabber. When the krasis hits a creature with its claws, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13} for category 1, {@dc 15} for category 2, and {@dc 19} for category 3) by a specialized grasping appendage on the krasis. It can have only one creature {@condition grappled} in this way at a time.

numericDifferences.english: Regeneration. The krasis regains hit points (2 for a category 1, 5 for a category 2, and 10 for a category 3) at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 hit point.
numericDifferences.localized: 再生。融合體在其回合開始時，如果它至少還有1點生命值，則它恢復一定生命值（融合體一型恢復2點，融合體二型恢復5點，融合體三型恢復10點）。

numericDifferences.english: Leaping Legs. With or without a running start, the krasis's long jump is 20 feet (category 1), 30 feet (category 2), or 40 feet (category 3). Its high jump is 10 feet (category 1), 20 feet (category 2), or 30 feet (category 3).
numericDifferences.localized: 跳肢Leaping Legs。無論是否助跑，融合體的跳遠可以跨越的距離均為20尺（融合體一型）、30尺（融合體二型）或40尺（融合體三型），跳高躍起的距離為10尺（融合體一型）、20尺（融合體二型）或30尺（融合體三型）。

numericDifferences.english: {@bold Festering Wound.} Your hit point maximum is reduced by 1 every 24 hours the wound persists. If your hit point maximum drops to 0, you die. The wound heals if you receive magical healing. Alternatively, someone can tend to the wound and make a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check once every 24 hours. After ten successes, the wound heals.
numericDifferences.localized: {@bold 潰爛的傷口。}傷口每存在24小時，則你的生命值上限降低1。如果你的生命值因此降至0，則你死亡。該傷口在你接受魔法治療時恢復。此外，其他人可以每天一次的幫你照料傷口，並以此進行一次{@dc 15}的感知（{@skill Medicine||醫療}）檢定。檢定成功十次後，該傷口痊癒。

numericDifferences.localized: 當你追逐黃泉巨龍會進入凱博爾洞穴中時，從一個有12顆水晶發光的洞穴中挖出一種（也是唯一的一個）特殊種類的蘑菇。

numericDifferences.english: A creature that casts a spell of 1st level or higher in the area rolls on the {@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB} table in chapter 3 of the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}.
numericDifferences.localized: 在該區域施展1級或以上法術的生物將在《玩家手冊》第三章的{@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB|狂野魔法浪涌}表中進行{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}的狂野魔法浪湧檢定。

numericDifferences.english: Any necromancy spell of 1st level or higher cast within the zone is treated as if it were cast at a level one higher than the spell slot that was expended.
numericDifferences.localized: 任何在該區域內施放的1級或以上的死靈法術都將被視為額外高1級的效果來施展。

numericDifferences.english: Spells that deal fire damage are empowered here. Such a spell of 1st level or higher cast within the zone deals fire damage as if it were cast at a level one higher than the spell slot that was expended.
numericDifferences.localized: 造成火焰傷害的法術將在這裡獲得加成。在該區域內施放1級或更高等級的法術會造成火焰傷害，並視為額外高1級的效果來施展。

numericDifferences.english: Clusters of radiant crystals sprout from the earth. A spell of 1st level or higher cast within 30 feet of these crystals, if it restores hit points or deals radiant damage, is treated as if it were cast at a level one higher than the spell slot that was expended.
numericDifferences.localized: 一簇簇發光的晶體從地球上冒出。在離這些水晶 30 尺範圍內施放 1 級或以上的法術，如果它能恢復生命值或造成光耀傷害，將視為額外高 1 級的效果來施展。

numericDifferences.english: Spells that summon elementals are empowered here. Such a spell of 1st level or higher cast within the zone is treated as if it were cast at a level one higher than the spell slot that was expended.
numericDifferences.localized: 召喚元素生物的法術在這裡被強化力量。在該區域內施放的1級或更高階別的此類法術將視為額外高1級的效果來施展。

numericDifferences.english: Spells that deal cold damage are empowered here. Such a spell of 1st level or higher cast within the zone deals cold damage as if it were cast at a level one higher than the spell slot that was expended.
numericDifferences.localized: 造成寒冷傷害的法術在這裡被強化。在該區域內施放1級或更高等級的法術將視為額外高1級的效果來施展。

numericDifferences.english: Reality is frayed here. Casting any spell of 1st level or higher triggers a roll on the {@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB} table in chapter 3 of the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}.
numericDifferences.localized: 現實在這裡被磨損了。施展任何1級或更高階別的法術，都會觸發在{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}第三章中的{@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB|狂野魔法浪涌}表。

numericDifferences.english: This place is haunted by fragments of the Far Realm. Whenever the target of a Wisdom saving throw fails its save, that creature has a {@chance 5} chance of becoming afflicted by a random form of long-term madness (see "{@book Madness|DMG|8|Madness}" in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}).
numericDifferences.localized: 該地點被遙遠國度的片段所困擾。每當某個生物在感知豁免檢定中失敗時，該生物有{@chance 5}的機率受到隨機形態的長期性瘋狂影響（參見{@book 瘋狂|DMG|8|Madness}在{@book 城主指南|DMG}第八章中）。

numericDifferences.english: You and this person were affected by powerful magic, and now you both share a telepathic connection that functions while you are within 1 mile of each other.
numericDifferences.localized: 你和這個人曾受到強大的魔法影響，令你們擁有了互相心靈感應的能力，你們在一英里範圍內可以隨時相互交流。

numericDifferences.english: You were press-ganged into military service, and were left shaken by what you saw on the battlefield. You have proficiency with medium armor, shields, and martial weapons. You also have a random form of indefinite madness, determined by rolling on the {@table indefinite madness||Indefinite Madness table} in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}.
numericDifferences.localized: 你曾被強行徵入軍隊，戰場上的見聞讓你深受打擊。你獲得中甲、盾牌和軍用武器熟練項。你同時隨機獲得了一項永久性瘋狂，透過使用{@book 城主指南|DMG}第八章中的{@table indefinite madness||永久性瘋狂表}擲骰決定。

numericDifferences.english: You were visited by a demon lord in a dream. You awakened knowing the {@spell find familiar} spell and are now able to cast it as a ritual, but your familiar always takes the form of a {@creature quasit}. You also have a random form of indefinite madness, determined by rolling on the {@table indefinite madness||Indefinite Madness table} in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}.
numericDifferences.localized: 一位惡魔領主曾拜訪了你的夢境。你醒來後便習得了{@spell find familiar||尋獲魔寵}法術並且能夠將該法術作為儀式來施放，但你的魔寵將永遠會是{@creature quasit||小惡魔}的形態。同時你隨機獲得了一項永久性瘋狂，透過使用{@book 城主指南|DMG}第八章中的{@table indefinite madness||永久性瘋狂表}擲骰決定。

numericDifferences.english: One or more creatures in the area chase after you! The DM chooses these pursuers or rolls a {@dice d8} to determine them: (1) 2 {@creature brown bear||brown bears}, (2) {@dice 2d4} {@creature giant toad||giant toads}, (3) {@dice 1d4} {@creature poisonous snake||poisonous snakes}, (4) {@dice 2d4} {@creature wolf||wolves}, (5) 1 {@creature giant boar}, (6) 2 {@creature dire wolf||dire wolves}, (7) {@creature griffon}, or (8) {@dice 1d12} {@creature giant rat||giant rats} (see the {@book Monster Manual|MM} for the creatures' game statistics).
numericDifferences.localized: 一個或多個生物在區域內追逐你！DM選擇這些追擊者，或者擲一個{@dice d8}來確定它們：(1) 2 只{@creature brown bear||棕熊}，(2) 擲{@dice 2d4}只{@creature giant toad||巨蟾}，(3) 擲{@dice 1d4}條{@creature poisonous snake||毒蛇}，(4) 擲{@dice 2d4}只{@creature wolf||狼}，(5) 1 只{@creature giant boar||鉅野豬}，(6) 2 只{@creature dire wolf||恐狼}，(7) 1 只{@creature griffon||獅鷲}，或者(8) 擲{@dice 1d12}只{@creature giant rat||巨鼠}（檢視{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}以獲取生物的遊戲具體數值）。

numericDifferences.localized: 一件至少傳承了3個世代的古董

numericDifferences.english: A gallon of any effervescent fluid
numericDifferences.localized: 1 一加侖任意營養液

numericDifferences.english: One character in the region is suffused with celestial power. For 1 minute, the character's melee attacks deal an extra {@dice 2d6} radiant damage on a hit.
numericDifferences.localized: 區域中的一位角色被浸於天界的力量之中。一分鐘內，該角色的近戰攻擊在命中時造成額外{@dice 2d6}光耀傷害。

numericDifferences.english: A booming voice thunders in Celestial and can be heard throughout the region. Each creature in the region must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a success, the creature gains {@dice 2d10} temporary hit points. On a failure, the creature is {@condition deafened} for 1 minute.
numericDifferences.localized: 天界語的隆隆雷音響徹整個區域。每個區域內的生物必須進行{@dc 15}的體質豁免。成功的情況下，生物獲得{@dice 2d10}臨時生命值。失敗的情況下，生物陷入{@condition deafened||耳聾}狀態一分鐘。

numericDifferences.english: One random creature in the region hears strange whispers and must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition charmed}. While {@condition charmed} in this way, the creature focuses on copying the blasphemous designs that appear in its mind using whatever medium it has available (ink, charcoal, mud, or its own blood). Unless {@condition restrained}, the creature completes the designs in 1 hour of work. When the creature finishes its work, it is no longer {@condition charmed}, and a {@creature death slaad} appears within 30 feet of it and attacks anyone in sight.
numericDifferences.localized: 區域內一個隨機生物聆聽到詭異的低語，必須成功透過{@dc 14}的感知豁免否則被{@condition charmed||魅惑}。以此方式被{@condition charmed||魅惑}時，該生物會專注於以它擁有的任何媒介（墨水、木炭、泥漿或自己的鮮血）複製自己腦海中瀆神的圖案。除非被{@condition restrained||束縛}，否則它將在一小時內完成繪製。當生物完成工作後，它將不再被{@condition charmed||魅惑}，一隻{@creature death slaad||史拉亡蟾}出現在它的30尺內，並攻擊一切看到的生物。

numericDifferences.english: During the next night, one random sleeping creature vanishes and reappears approximately a foot beneath where they were sleeping—typically buried in undisturbed dirt or in a space beneath floorboards. The creature or someone else can free it with a successful {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
numericDifferences.localized: 在下一個夜晚中，一個隨機睡著的生物會消失並出現在睡下之處的地下1尺——通常是被毫無知覺地埋在泥土或者地板下層中。該生物或其他人可以透過成功的{@dc 13}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定解救它。

numericDifferences.english: A mysterious mist rises from the shadows. This dense fog heavily obscures everything in a 50-foot-radius sphere around one random creature in the region. Any creature that starts its turn in the mist must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of {@condition exhaustion}. This {@condition exhaustion} can't be removed while the creature is in the mist. Additionally, creatures notice unsettling sights through the fog, such as ominous ruins or soundless silhouettes fleeing pursuit. The mists can't be dispersed by any wind, but clear after 1 minute.
numericDifferences.localized: 一股神秘的霧氣自陰影中升起。濃霧會對以區域內一個隨機生物為中心、50尺半徑球狀區域內的一切構成重度遮蔽。任何在霧中開始回合的生物必須成功透過{@dc 10}的體質豁免否則獲得一級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}。在霧氣中時，該{@condition exhaustion||力竭}無法被去除。此外，生物會在霧中看到令人不安的景象，比如不祥的廢墟或無聲的人影在逃離追捕。霧氣無法被任何風所吹散，但會在1分鐘後自行消失。

numericDifferences.english: A swarm of bioluminescent flies converges on one random creature in the region. For the next minute, the creature sheds {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} in a 10-foot radius, any attack against it has advantage if the attacker can see it, and the creature can't benefit from being {@condition invisible}.
numericDifferences.localized: 一群發光蠅群聚集在該區域內的一個隨機生物身上。在接下來的1分鐘內，該生物在10尺半徑內散發出{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}，任何能看見它的攻擊手對其進行的攻擊都具有優勢，並且該生物無法從{@condition invisible||隱形}狀態中獲益。

numericDifferences.english: Countless tiny, bloodsucking insects infest the region for the next {@dice 1d6} hours. Every hour, each creature in the region must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of {@condition exhaustion}. The insects don't affect creatures that are immune to disease.
numericDifferences.localized: 無數的吸血昆蟲在接下來{@dice 1d6}小時中這一區域肆虐。每個小時，每個區域中的生物必須成功透過{@dc 10}的體質豁免否則獲得一級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}。這些昆蟲無法影響免疫疾病的生物。

numericDifferences.english: Two shimmering, vertical, reflective disks of energy appear in unoccupied spaces in the region for 1 minute. Each is 6 feet in diameter and floats 1 foot above the ground. One appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the party. Any creature that moves through the disk instantly appears within 5 feet of the other disk or the nearest unoccupied space.
numericDifferences.localized: 兩個反光的直立圓盤出現在區域內未被佔據的空間並持續存在一分鐘。每個圓盤直徑6尺，浮在地面以上1尺高度。其中一個出現在隊伍30尺範圍內未被佔據空間內。任何透過一個圓盤的生物會立即出現在另一個圓盤旁未被佔據的5尺內。

numericDifferences.english: Floating shards of broken mirrors swirl through the region, showing reflections of creatures and places that aren't present, for the next minute before vanishing. On initiative count 20 (losing all ties), the shards make a ranged weapon attack ({@hit 6} to hit) against one random creature in the region. On a hit, the target takes 10 ({@dice 3d6}) slashing damage.
numericDifferences.localized: 破碎鏡子的漂浮碎片在該區域盤旋，顯現出並不存在的生物和地點的鏡影，持續1分鐘後消失。在先攻值20（輸掉所有平局）時，碎片對該區域內的一個隨機生物進行一次遠端武器攻擊（命中+{@hit 6}）。若命中，目標受到10（{@dice 3d6}）點揮砍傷害。

numericDifferences.english: For 1 minute on initiative count 20 (losing all ties), Tiny and Small objects in the region that aren't being worn or carried are flung by an unseen force. One random creature in the region must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take {@dice 2d4} bludgeoning damage from the flung objects.
numericDifferences.localized: 在一分鐘內，先攻輪到20時（同先攻值最後），區域內未被穿戴或攜帶的微型和小型物件會被看不見的力量所扔出。區域內的一個隨機生物必須成功透過{@dc 15}的敏捷豁免否則因為亂扔的物件而受到{@dice 2d4}鈍擊傷害。

numericDifferences.english: Psychic power builds in the mind of one random creature in the region. Once within the next minute, the creature can use a bonus action to magically assault the mind of another creature it can see. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw or take {@dice 4d10} psychic damage.
numericDifferences.localized: 區域中一個隨機生物的頭腦中獲得了靈能的力量。接下來的1分鐘內僅一次，該生物能夠使用附贈動作對另一個它能看見的生物的心靈發動魔法攻擊。目標必須成功透過{@dc 14}的智力豁免否則受到{@dice 4d10}心靈傷害。

numericDifferences.english: For 1 hour, each creature in the region gains the ability to communicate telepathically with any creature it can see within 60 feet. If the target understands any languages, it can respond telepathically.
numericDifferences.localized: 一小時內，區域中的每個生物都獲得與它能看見的60尺內任何生物進行心靈感應交流的能力。如果目標理解任何語言，它便能以心靈感應進行回覆。

numericDifferences.english: Thoughts in the region attract ambient psychic energy, forming protective fields around creatures' minds. Creatures in the region gain resistance to psychic damage for the next hour.
numericDifferences.localized: 區域中的思想會引來環境中的靈能，在生物心智周圍形成保護力場。在接下來1小時內，區域中的所有生物獲得心靈傷害的抗性。

numericDifferences.english: For 1 minute on initiative count 20 (losing all ties), one random creature in the region must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or take {@dice 2d6} psychic damage.
numericDifferences.localized: 在一分鐘內，先攻輪到20時（同先攻值最後），一個區域內的隨機生物必須成功透過{@dc 15}的智力豁免否則受到{@dice 2d6}心靈傷害。

numericDifferences.english: Five teeth
numericDifferences.localized: 5顆牙齒

numericDifferences.english: Characters emerge on stable ground a mile from where they entered the Mists at midnight of the night after they entered the Mists.
numericDifferences.localized: 角色們出現在離他們踏入迷霧時的地點1英里處的穩固地面上，此時正是他們踏入迷霧後的當天午夜。

numericDifferences.english: The character broadcasts their surface thoughts for 1 round, as if all creatures within 30 feet of them had cast {@spell detect thoughts} targeting them.
numericDifferences.localized: 該角色在一輪內展現自己的表層思維，如同30尺內的所有生物都對其施放了{@spell detect thoughts||偵測思想}。

numericDifferences.english: The character casts {@spell fireball} as a 5th-level spell centered on themself using Charisma as the spellcasting ability. Screams and laughter emanate from the flames.
numericDifferences.localized: 角色以魅力作為施法關鍵屬性，以自身為源點施展{@spell fireball||火球術}作為五環法術。火焰中會傳來尖叫和笑聲。

numericDifferences.english: A {@creature swarm of rats} shadows the character as they travel. If confronted, the swarm attacks. Anyone bitten by the rats must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or contract the Gnawing Plague.
numericDifferences.localized: 1窩{@creature swarm of rats||鼠群}在角色們的旅程中尾隨他們。如果看到了，鼠群就會立即發動攻擊。任何被老鼠咬傷的人必須透過{@dc 14}的體質豁免，否則就會感染齧磨鼠疫。

numericDifferences.english: Clouds of insects, persistent leeches, or other parasites torment the party. Each character must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check or gain 1 level of {@condition exhaustion}. Creatures immune to disease suffer no ill effects from the parasites.
numericDifferences.localized: 成群的昆蟲、頑固的水蛭或其他寄生蟲折磨著隊伍。每個角色必須透過{@dc 16}感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定否則獲得一級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}。對疾病免疫的生物不會受到寄生蟲的不良影響。

numericDifferences.english: The party chooses one character who must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check. On a failed check, the party becomes lost. It takes the characters 1 hour to realize they are {@dice 1d4} miles away from their assumed location in a disadvantageous direction.
numericDifferences.localized: 隊伍選擇一個角色，他必須成功透過{@dc 16}的感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定。如果檢定不透過，則隊伍會迷失方向。角色們一個小時之後才會意識到，他們已經在錯誤的方向上距離原定的位置偏離了{@dice 1d4}英里。

numericDifferences.english: An amethyst dragon magically disables all teleportation within a thousand miles of their lair. Governments within that area seek emissaries who can negotiate an end to the restriction.
numericDifferences.localized: 一條紫晶龍以魔法手段使其巢穴周圍1000英里內的傳送盡數失效。當地政府尋求一夥能夠去與之談判結束禁制的特使。

numericDifferences.english: The lost secret to forging an alloy imbued with arcane potential, etched on twelve metal disks the size of dinner plates
numericDifferences.localized: 一個失傳之秘，關於如何熔鍊某種蘊含奧秘潛能的合金，被蝕刻在12張餐盤大小的金屬圓盤上。

numericDifferences.english: Tale of the Renowned Duelist. You make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes force damage equal to two rolls of your Bardic Inspiration die + your Charisma modifier.
numericDifferences.localized: 著名決鬥家之談。你對目標進行一次近戰法術攻擊。命中時，目標受到的力場傷害等於擲 2 顆詩人激勵骰的結果，加上你的魅力調整值。

numericDifferences.english: Tale of the Beloved Friends. The target and another creature of its choice it can see within 5 feet of it gains temporary hit points equal to a roll of your Bardic Inspiration die + your Charisma modifier.
numericDifferences.localized: 摯友之談。目標與其選擇的另一個可見、位於其 5 尺內的生物，各獲得臨時生命值，數值等於擲 1 顆詩人激勵骰的結果，加上你的魅力調整值。

numericDifferences.english: Tale of the Avenger. For 1 minute, any creature that hits the target with a melee attack takes force damage equal to a roll of your Bardic Inspiration die.
numericDifferences.localized: 復仇者的故事 Tale of the Avenger。在1分鐘裡，任何使用近戰攻擊命中目標的生物會受到相當於1個你的詩人激勵骰的擲骰結果的力場傷害。

numericDifferences.english: Tale of the Phantom. The target becomes {@condition invisible} until the end of its next turn or until it hits a creature with an attack. If the target hits a creature with an attack during this invisibility, the creature it hits takes necrotic damage equal to a roll of your Bardic Inspiration die and is {@condition frightened} of the target until the end of the {@condition frightened} creature's next turn.
numericDifferences.localized: 鬼魅的故事Tale of the Phantom目標變為{@condition invisible||隱形}，直到其下一個回合結束，或以攻擊命中一個生物。如果目標在這次隱形期間攻擊命中了一個生物，被攻擊的生物受到暗蝕傷害，數值等同於1個你的詩人激勵骰的擲骰結果，並陷入對目標的{@condition frightened||恐慌}之中，{@condition frightened||恐慌}效果持續到該生物的下一個回合結束。

numericDifferences.english: Tale of the Brute. Each creature of the target's choice it can see within 30 feet of it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes thunder damage equal to three rolls of your Bardic Inspiration die and is knocked {@condition prone}. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw takes half as much damage and isn't knocked {@condition prone}.
numericDifferences.localized: 兇蠻惡漢的故事 Tale of the Brute。目標所選擇的30尺內其可見的每個生物都必須進行一次力量豁免。若豁免失敗，該生物受到3個你的詩人激勵骰的擲骰結果的雷鳴傷害，並{@condition prone||倒地}。若豁免成功，該生物受到的傷害減半，並且不會{@condition prone||倒地}。

numericDifferences.english: Tale of the Dragon. The target spews fire from the mouth in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking fire damage equal to four rolls of your Bardic Inspiration die on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
numericDifferences.localized: 巨龍的故事 Tale of the Dragon。目標從口中噴出30尺錐形的火焰。在範圍內的每個生物都必須進行一次敏捷豁免，若豁免失敗則受到4個你的詩人激勵骰的擲骰結果的火焰傷害，若豁免則成功傷害減半。

numericDifferences.english: Tale of the Mind-Bender. You evoke an incomprehensible fable from an otherworldly being. The target must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or take psychic damage equal to three rolls of your Bardic Inspiration die and be {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.
numericDifferences.localized: 奪魂故事 Tale of the Mind-Bender。你從某個超凡的存在那裡喚起了一則超越人的理解能力的寓言。目標必須成功透過一次智力豁免，否則受到相當於3個你的詩人激勵骰的擲骰結果的心靈傷害，並被{@condition stunned||震懾}直到其下一個回合結束。

numericDifferences.english: Roll on this table at the start of each of your turns for the next minute, ignoring this result on subsequent rolls.
numericDifferences.localized: 下1分鐘內，你在每次自己回合開始時重骰本表，並在後續的擲骰中跳過本結果。

numericDifferences.english: For the next minute, you can see any {@condition invisible} creature if you have line of sight to it.
numericDifferences.localized: 下1分鐘內，你可以看到任何處於你視線範圍內的{@condition invisible||隱形}生物。

numericDifferences.english: For the next minute, you regain 5 hit points at the start of each of your turns.
numericDifferences.localized: 下1分鐘內，你在每次自己回合開始時恢復5點生命值。

numericDifferences.english: Creatures have disadvantage on saving throws against the next spell you cast in the next minute that involves a saving throw.
numericDifferences.localized: 下1分鐘內，你施展第一個需要豁免檢定的法術時，其目標生物進行檢定時具有劣勢。

numericDifferences.english: An eye appears on your forehead for the next minute. During that time, you have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.
numericDifferences.localized: 你的前額長出第三隻眼並持續存在1分鐘。下1分鐘內，你所有依賴視覺進行的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定具有優勢。

numericDifferences.english: For the next minute, all your spells with a casting time of 1 action have a casting time of 1 bonus action.
numericDifferences.localized: 在下1分鐘內，你所有的施法時間為1動作的法術施法時間變為1附贈動作。

numericDifferences.english: Maximize the damage of the next damaging spell you cast within the next minute.
numericDifferences.localized: 下1分鐘內，你施展下一個傷害性法術時其傷害擲骰取滿值。

numericDifferences.english: For the next minute, you can teleport up to 20 feet as a bonus action on each of your turns.
numericDifferences.localized: 下1分鐘內，你可以在每個自己回合內以一個附贈動作傳送至多20尺。

numericDifferences.english: You can't speak for the next minute. Whenever you try, pink bubbles float out of your mouth.
numericDifferences.localized: 下1分鐘內，你無法說話。你一張嘴就會吐出粉色的泡泡。

numericDifferences.english: A spectral shield hovers near you for the next minute, granting you a +2 bonus to AC and immunity to {@spell magic missile}.
numericDifferences.localized: 下1分鐘內，一面鬼靈盾牌保護著你，為你的AC提供 +2加值，並使你免疫{@spell magic missile||魔法飛彈}。

numericDifferences.english: For the next minute, any flammable object you touch that isn't being worn or carried by another creature bursts into flame.
numericDifferences.localized: 下1分鐘內，你接觸的任何未被人著裝或攜帶的可燃物都會被點燃。

numericDifferences.english: For the next minute, you must shout when you speak.
numericDifferences.localized: 下1分鐘內，你說話時只能喊叫。

numericDifferences.english: You gain resistance to all damage for the next minute.
numericDifferences.localized: 下1分鐘內，你具有所有型別傷害的抗性。

numericDifferences.english: You glow with bright light in a 30-foot radius for the next minute. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of you is {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.
numericDifferences.localized: 下1分鐘內，你發出30尺半徑的明亮光照。任何在你周邊5尺範圍內結束其回合的生物將陷入{@condition blinded||目盲}，並持續至其下一回合結束。

numericDifferences.english: Illusory butterflies and flower petals flutter in the air within 10 feet of you for the next minute.
numericDifferences.localized: 下1分鐘內，你身邊10尺範圍不斷出現虛幻的蝴蝶和花瓣。

numericDifferences.english: You become {@condition invisible} for the next minute. During that time, other creatures can't hear you. The invisibility ends if you attack or cast a spell.
numericDifferences.localized: 下1分鐘內，你進入{@condition invisible||隱形}，且其他生物無法聽見你的聲音。你一旦施法或攻擊則隱形結束。

numericDifferences.english: If you die within the next minute, you immediately come back to life as if by the {@spell reincarnate} spell.
numericDifferences.localized: 如果你在下1分鐘內死亡，則你立刻復活，如同被施展法術{@spell reincarnate||轉生術}。

numericDifferences.english: Your size increases by one size category for the next minute.
numericDifferences.localized: 下1分鐘內，你的體型暫時變大一級。

numericDifferences.english: You and all creatures within 30 feet of you gain vulnerability to piercing damage for the next minute.
numericDifferences.localized: 下1分鐘內，你和你身邊30尺內所有生物獲得穿刺傷害的易傷。

numericDifferences.english: You are surrounded by faint, ethereal music for the next minute.
numericDifferences.localized: 下1分鐘內，你被空靈的音樂聲環繞。

numericDifferences.english: Roll on this table at the start of each of your turns for the next minute, ignoring this result on subsequent rolls.
numericDifferences.localized: 下 1 分鐘內，你在每次自己回合開始時重骰本表，並在後續的擲骰中跳過本結果。

numericDifferences.english: For the next minute, you regain 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of your turns.
numericDifferences.localized: 下 1 分鐘內，你在每個自己的回合開始時恢復 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}。

numericDifferences.english: Creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws against the next spell you cast in the next minute that involves a saving throw.
numericDifferences.localized: 下 1 分鐘內，你施展第一個需要豁免的法術時，成為該法術目標的生物進行豁免時具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。

numericDifferences.english: For the next minute, all your spells with a casting time of an action have a casting time of a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.
numericDifferences.localized: 下 1 分鐘內，你所有的施法時間為動作的法術施法時間變為{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}。

numericDifferences.english: The next time you cast a spell that deals damage within the next minute, don't roll the spell's damage dice for the damage. Instead use the highest number possible for each damage die.
numericDifferences.localized: 下 1 分鐘內，你施展的下一道造成傷害的法術的傷害不進行傷害擲骰而是取所有傷害骰的最大值。

numericDifferences.english: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all damage for the next minute.
numericDifferences.localized: 下 1 分鐘內，你具有所有傷害型別的{@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|抗性}。

numericDifferences.english: For the next minute, you can teleport up to 20 feet as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your turns.
numericDifferences.localized: 下 1 分鐘內，你能夠在每個自己回合內以一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}傳送至多 20 尺。

numericDifferences.english: You and up to three creatures you choose within 30 feet of you have the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. This invisibility ends on a creature immediately after it makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.
numericDifferences.localized: 你和至多 3 名 30 尺內由你選擇的生物獲得{@condition Invisible|XPHB|隱形}狀態，持續 1 分鐘。此隱形會在該生物發動攻擊、造成傷害或施展法術後立即結束。

numericDifferences.english: A spectral shield hovers near you for the next minute, granting you a +2 bonus to AC and immunity to {@spell Magic Missile|XPHB}.
numericDifferences.localized: 下 1 分鐘內，一面靈體般的盾牌懸浮在你的周圍，為你的AC提供 +2 加值，並使你免疫{@spell Magic Missile|XPHB|魔法飛彈}。

numericDifferences.english: For the next minute, any flammable, nonmagical object you touch that isn't being worn or carried by another creature bursts into flame, takes {@damage 1d4} Fire damage, and is burning.
numericDifferences.localized: 下 1 分鐘內，你觸碰的任何未被其他生物著裝或攜帶的非魔法可燃物件都會燃起火焰，受到{@damage 1d4}火焰傷害，並開始燃燒。
