numericReview.english: The malfunctioning Phase Transference Emitter consists of two primary components. The power battery is a 10-foot circular matrix of conduction coils wired directly to a generator via a secure power cable. The coils have ten nodes that connect to a large eight-foot tall cylindrical steel emitter rigged on a swivel.
numericReview.localized: 故障的相位轉移發射器由兩個主要部分組成。電源電池是一個10尺直徑的傳導線圈矩陣，透過一根安全電源電纜直接連線到發電機。線圈有十個節點，連線到一個大型的8尺高的圓柱形鋼製發射器上，該發射器安裝在一個旋轉裝置上。
review: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericReview.english: This gold key is 4 feet long and weighs 100 pounds. One round after it is removed from the sword stand, it comes to life, revealing itself to be a living object (use the {@creature flying sword} stat block). The key does everything it can to return to its stand, attacking anyone who tries to stop it. If the key is destroyed by reducing it to 0 hit points, it must be repaired (such as with the {@spell Mending} spell) before it can be used in the skull door.
numericReview.localized: 這把黃金鑰匙長4尺，重100磅。在它被從劍架上取下的1輪後，他會獲得生命，使自己變化一個活體的物件（使用 {@creature flying sword||凌空劍} 的資料）。這把鑰匙會盡自己可能的嘗試返回它的劍架上，並會攻擊任何阻攔它的生物。如果鑰匙因為生命值歸零而被摧毀，則它必須被修復（例如使用法術 {@spell Mending||修復術}）之後才能被用來開啟頭骨之門。
review: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericReview.english: Traveling at altitudes of 10,000 feet or higher above sea level is taxing for most creatures because of the reduced amount of oxygen in the air. Each hour such a creature spends traveling at high altitude counts as 2 hours for the purpose of determining how long that creature can travel (see "{@book Travel Pace|XDMG|1|Travel Pace}" in {@book chapter 2|XDMG|1}).
numericReview.localized: 由於空氣中的氧氣含量減少的原因，在海拔10000尺或更高的地方旅行對大多數生物來說都是一種負擔。計算生物的旅行時間時，生物在高海拔地區旅行的每1個小時都被算作2個小時（見{@book 第二章|XDMG|1} {@book 旅行步調|XDMG|1|Travel Pace} 一節）。
review: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericReview.english: A lightning storm lasts for 1 hour. After each minute spent in the area of a lightning storm, a creature rolls {@b {@dice 1d6}}; on a 1, lightning streaks down to strike the creature. The creature makes a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@b {@dice 3d10}} Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
numericReview.localized: 閃電風暴持續1小時。在閃電風暴區域內每停留1分鐘後，生物需投擲{@b {@dice 1d6}}；結果為1時，閃電會劈下打擊該生物。該生物需進行{@dc 15}的敏捷豁免，豁免失敗則受到{@b {@dice 3d10}}閃電傷害，豁免成功則只受一半傷害。
review: same numeric value set; repetition/formatting only

numericReview.english: A creature needs an amount of food per day based on its size, as shown in the Food Needs per Day table. A creature that eats but consumes less than half the required food for a day must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB|saving throw} or gain 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level at the day's end. A creature that eats nothing for 5 days automatically gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level at the end of the fifth day as well as an additional level at the end of each subsequent day without food.
numericReview.localized: 生物每天需要攝入一定量的食物，其需求量由體型決定，如下方每日食物需求表所示。若生物在一天中吃下的食物低於這個量的一半，其在本日結束時必須透過一次{@dc 10}的體質{@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB|豁免檢定}，否則將會獲得 1 級{@condition Exhaustion|XPHB|力竭}等級。而連續五天什麼也不吃的生物會在第五天結束時自動獲得 1 層額外的{@condition Exhaustion|XPHB|力竭}等級，在這之後若繼續什麼也不吃，其每天結束時都將會獲得1層額外的力竭等級。
review: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericReview.english: The winds of {@book Pandemonium|XDMG|5|Pandemonium} are common in Pandemonium and regions where its influence is felt, including parts of the Underdark. A creature makes a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw after each hour spent among the howling winds. On a failed save, the creature gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level. The winds can't increase a creature's {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level above 3. Finishing a Long Rest doesn't reduce a creature's Exhaustion level unless the creature can somehow escape the winds.
numericReview.localized: 喧癲空隧的狂風常出現在{@book 喧癲空隧|XDMG|5|Pandemonium}位面和受其影響的地區，包括幽暗地域的部分地區。一個生物在尖嘯狂風中每經過1個小時將進行一次{@dc 10}的感知豁免，如果豁免失敗，該生物獲得1級{@condition Exhaustion|XPHB|力竭}。狂風不能將生物的{@condition Exhaustion|XPHB|力竭}等級提高到3級以上。長休無法降低狂風中的生物的力竭等級，除非該生物能夠以某種方式避開狂風肆虐。
review: same numeric value set; repetition/formatting only

numericReview.english: Poisonous gas is usually encountered in an enclosed space, such as a sewer or sealed tomb. The gas fills as much space as it can, up to a maximum of ten 10-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cubes}. The transparent gas carries a foul odor. The gas is continuously or periodically replenished by some natural or magical source, though a strong wind disperses the gas for 1 minute.
